variants.name: A-gallery
variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Design exploration for existing Chinese HarmonyOS app 冰箱贴. Use reference 1 ONLY for existing visual language: pure white background, dark monochrome native symbols, floating white pills with ultra soft shadows, spacious canvas stage, bottom tools. Use reference 2 ONLY for artwork: tactile cutout pets with white outline, torn cream paper digital clock, orange board, realistic subtle wood frame. Create a high fidelity UX presentation board with TWO large equal portrait phone screens side by side, straight-on, legible Chinese, neutral warm-white backdrop, small restrained caption above each screen and board title at top. Screens must show believable native mobile app UI, not a marketing poster. Keep controls touch-friendly, typography restrained. Show different canvas sizes 4×4, 2×4, 2×2 naturally. Other artwork themes can be cream rabbit with date, sage paper timetable, sky blue corgi battery. App chrome monochrome, color only inside user artworks. No bottom sheets, no popups, no modal overlay, no dimmed background. No desktop binding controls or widget settings in these screens. This is browsing and editing locally saved canvases. Don't show phone hardware frame. Direction A: fundamentally redesign home into a full-page visual canvas library. Board title 'A · 先看作品，再进入创作'. LEFT screen caption '首页 · 作品一目了然'. Header '我的画布' with small secondary count '6 张画布', small top right import symbol and plus button. Under header compact understated filter pills '全部' selected black, '4×4', '2×4', '2×2'. Main screen is spacious two-column masonry gallery with true aspect ratio previews on very light warm gray tiles. First orange pet collage 4×4, title below '日常陪伴', secondary '4×4'; another square blue corgi '电量搭子' 2×2; wide cat clock '猫咪时钟' 2×4 spans both columns; two other smaller paper art canvases visible lower down. Names and three-dot menu outside artwork. No heavy borders or large colored section backgrounds. Bottom small floating black capsule '+ 新建画布', no editor tools on library home. RIGHT caption '编辑 · 清晰返回作品库'. Top left a back chevron with text '画布', center small title '猫咪时钟' and '2×4', top right ellipsis. Main view is enlarged orange framed horizontal cat clock centered with substantial breathing space. Bottom float pills '图层', '定时', palette symbol, plus. Just below artwork tiny muted text '已自动保存'. The back button makes library-to-editor navigation obvious, no need for explanatory arrows. Make this direction feel like a refined creative app gallery with emphasis on artwork and clear hierarchy.

Use reference 1 ONLY for existing visual language: pure white background, dark monochrome native symbols, floating white pills with ultra soft shadows, spacious canvas stage, bottom tools. Use reference 2 ONLY for artwork: tactile cutout pets with white outline, torn cream paper digital clock, orange board, realistic subtle wood frame. Create a high fidelity UX presentation board with TWO large equal portrait phone screens side by side, straight-on, legible Chinese, neutral warm-white backdrop, small restrained caption above each screen and board title at top. Other artwork themes can be cream rabbit with date, sage paper timetable, sky blue corgi battery. App chrome monochrome, color only inside user artworks. No bottom sheets, no popups, no modal overlay, no dimmed background. No desktop binding controls or widget settings in these screens. This is browsing and editing locally saved canvases. Don't show phone hardware frame. Direction B: a full screen horizontal swipe workbench with nearby canvases physically visible, no separate library as primary flow. Board title 'B · 左右翻，一张接一张'. LEFT caption '浏览 · 相邻画布自然露出'. Top left tiny grid outline symbol as secondary overview entry; top center '我的画布', top right plus inside small white circle. In main center show an orange square framed pet collage taking about 78% screen width. At far left and right show narrow clipped portions of two adjacent artwork canvases, clearly horizontal carousel pages with equal center alignment; center artwork much more visible than neighbors. Under central artwork text '日常陪伴' then smaller '4×4 · 2 / 6' and restrained pagination dots. Bottom tools four airy pills: '编辑画布', clock symbol, palette symbol, plus. RIGHT caption '编辑 · 锁定当前画布'. Top left '完成', centered '日常陪伴 · 4×4', top right undo arrow. Same canvas enlarged to available width, only one canvas shown now, selection handles around a small paper date card within it; bottom floating pills '图层', '定时', palette, plus. A thin small mode label under canvas '编辑中'. Distinction between browsing swipe mode and editing mode is visual and clear. In browse state full canvas swipe changes artwork; in editing state gestures move cards, no adjacent peeking pages. Keep canvas as main content, no gallery rows or thumbnail filmstrip.

variants.name: C-filmstrip

Use reference 1 ONLY for existing visual language: pure white background, dark monochrome native symbols, floating white pills with ultra soft shadows, spacious canvas stage, bottom tools. Use reference 2 ONLY for artwork: tactile cutout pets with white outline, torn cream paper digital clock, orange board, realistic subtle wood frame. Create a high fidelity UX presentation board with TWO large equal portrait phone screens side by side, straight-on, legible Chinese, neutral warm-white backdrop, small restrained caption above each screen and board title at top. Screens must show believable native mobile app UI, not a marketing poster. Keep controls touch-friendly, typography restrained. Show different canvas sizes 4×4, 2×4, 2×2 naturally. Don't show phone hardware frame. Direction C: persistent filmstrip as an integral part of the home workbench, one-tap switching while staying in the same screen. Board title 'C · 画布常驻，切换就在手边'. LEFT caption '工作台 · 缩略图直接切换'. Top small current canvas name '日常陪伴' with tiny badge '4×4', top right ellipsis. Main upper-middle stage contains large square orange framed pet collage, a refined playful composition with clock/date/pets. At lower screen, ABOVE the original floating editing tool row, a horizontal filmstrip on plain white background, NOT inside any sheet or rounded panel. Filmstrip shows three fully visible artwork thumbnails and a fourth partially clipped: orange square selected with thin black outline outside and tiny title '日常陪伴'; blue corgi square '电量搭子'; wide cat clock thumbnail '猫咪时钟'; cream rabbit partly visible. Thumbnails have consistent slot size with artwork aspect preserved inside slot, not stretched. At far right small '+' tile accessible by horizontal scroll. Below filmstrip retain floating pill controls '图层', '定时', palette symbol, plus. RIGHT caption '切换后 · 编辑位置保持稳定'. Same exact chrome, rail vertical position and tool row as left; selected canvas changes to '猫咪时钟' badge '2×4'; main workspace shows large horizontal orange sleeping cat and paper clock centered in same available stage, ample white space above/below; filmstrip selects cat clock item with black outline, other previews remain. No separate full-screen gallery, no bottom sheets, no pagination dots; keep rail always visible. Make persistent navigation clearly distinct from the artwork editing controls. No explanatory body prose inside screen.
